sql: with o as (select lo.market_ticker t, regexp_replace(lo.strategy,'_closeout$','') s, lo.side os, lo.action oa, f.side fs, f.price fp, coalesce((f.raw_fill_json->>'count_fp')::numeric, f.quantity) q, coalesce(f.fee,0) fee from live_orders lo join fills f on f.kalshi_order_id = lo.kalshi_order_id where lo.strategy not like 'Alimm%'), p as (select distinct on (market_ticker) market_ticker t, quantity, (raw_json->>'value')::numeric yv from positions order by market_ticker, captured_at desc), nt as (select t, count(distinct s) n from o group by t), per as (select o.s, o.t, sum(o.q) q, sum((case when o.oa='buy' then 1 else -1 end) * o.q * ((case when o.os='yes' then p.yv else 100 - p.yv end) - (case when o.fs = o.os then o.fp else 100 - o.fp end)))/100.0 - sum(o.fee) pnl from o join p on p.t = o.t join nt on nt.t = o.t where nt.n > 1 and p.quantity = 0 and p.yv is not null group by o.s, o.t) select s tag, count(*) contested_settled_markets, sum(q) contracts, round(sum(pnl)::numeric,4) pnl_usd, round(min(pnl)::numeric,4) worst_market_usd, sum(case when pnl < 0 then 1 else 0 end) losing_markets, string_agg(t, ' ' order by t) markets from per group by s order by s
